newsitem.title: DUBAI: U.S. Gulf helicopter crash kills one, two missing.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Gulf helicopter crash kills one, two missing.

text.p: One person was killed and two others were missing after a U.S. military helicopter crashed in the northern Gulf on Friday, the U.S. Navy said.
In a statement it said the Seahawk helicopter assigned to Carrier Air Wing 17 and the USS Enterprise aircraft carrier went down in the northern Gulf at about 0815 GMT with 12 people on board.
"One person died and two personnel are missing," said the statement from the U.S. Naval Forces Central Command in Bahrain, where the U.S. Fifth Fleet is based.

Nine people had been rescued and were being treated on board the Enterprise. The search for the two missing crew was continuing and an investigation would be conducted to determine the cause of the accident, it added.
The helicopter had been on a routine training exercise.
USS Enterprise and Carrier Air Wing 17 have been in the Gulf since September 19 conducting flight operations in support of Operation Southern Watch enforcing a "no-fly zone" over southern Iraq.
Names of the personnel on board the helicopter are being withheld until their next of kin are informed.
